🔑 Google Sign-In

Google Sign-In is ready
Requires a valid Google OAuth Client ID
To activate Google Sign-In on your live server:
1.Go to console.cloud.google.com → Create a project
2.Enable Google Identity Services API
3.Create OAuth credentials → Get your Client ID
4.Replace GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID in the JS with your actual Client ID
5.Add your domain to Authorised JavaScript Origins
